key_insight: Domain-adapted latent diffusion improved CT-to-PET image translation over the CPDM baseline, including pixel-wise reconstruction and localized tumor fidelity.
clinical_relevance: This imaging research—not drug discovery—could support more accessible metabolic imaging, but generated PET images are not established substitutes for acquired PET scans.
method: Transfer natural-image priors to CT-to-PET translation using domain-adapted latent diffusion.
Apply a signed power transform to address extreme PET intensity sparsity.
Evaluate with background-filtered and mask-restricted metrics.
evidence_signal: Using 21,930 paired CT/PET slices, the study reports improvements over CPDM and finds that standard full-image metrics can misrepresent translation quality.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish patient-level diagnostic accuracy or generalization across clinical settings.
paper_title: Domain-Adapted Latent Diffusion Models for CT-to-PET Image Translation
